execution.abandoned_cell_policy: an ambiguous billing outcome fails its CELL, not the run; the cell is left unrecorded and a later pass retries it. Guard trips at 90% of attempted cells or 100 abandoned in one pass.
execution.block_scheduling: condition-balanced round robin over ready cells, readiness recomputed each block. Batch cells depend on their sequential parents and so always run later; a work-conserving queue would give batch a systematically later slice of the run and land time-varying provider degradation preferentially on one co-primary.

width_is_a_hypothesis.gemma_cap_8: the only width with live evidence: 1179 ok / 238 abandoned (16.8%) over the later portion of the bridge canary, no worse than the 20.3% it showed at concurrency 1.
width_is_a_hypothesis.max_workers_16: NOT measured. The bridge canary ran 8. Doubling is a hypothesis.
width_is_a_hypothesis.revert_rule: if gemma abandonment over that window exceeds 25%, or cells/hour is below the bridge canary's 67, revert to max_workers 8 by amendment and record the measurement. Do not continue at a width that is not paying for itself.

forecast.basis: measured per-cell cost of the 2026-08-04 bridge canary, which ran the same pipeline over the 24 HELD-OUT questions. Main questions may differ in length and query behaviour, so this is an estimate from a related but not identical grid.

already_executed_elsewhere.under: the capability preflight's own manifest and authorization

reviewer.isolation: fresh isolated context per payload: no repository, tools, retrieval, conversation memory, or cross-query discussion
